reviews.reason: Intentional schema-dts graph-node inspection conversion. Graph merging and type compatibility are covered by resolver tests. Schema validity remains an upstream content contract.
Test-only fixture loader consuming repository-controlled JSON. The generic assertion is limited to integration test setup, not Worker runtime or production publishing.
Dynamic import is treated as an indexable module namespace. Export lookup is checked, and imported content remains unknown until downstream AJV-backed photo or journal validation.
Repository-generated JSON Schema is represented as a generic record and compiled by AJV. Invalid schemas fail validation setup before publication artifacts are generated.

Generic KV read adapter used by the controlled publishing CLI. Retrieved values follow the published content contract; downstream publication performs write verification and the Worker validates its own request-time KV boundaries. Residual risk from malformed existing KV values is accepted.
